+            raise RuntimeError(f"wrong_official_source_global_stop:{paper['paper_id']}")
+        paper_receipts.append({"paper_id": paper["paper_id"], "path": paper["source_path"], "pdf_sha256": digest})
+    region_count = 0
+    for question in questions:
+        for region in question["regions"]:
+            path = Path(region["crop_external_path"])
+            if not path.is_file() or sha256_file(path) != region.get("crop_sha256"):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"prepared_crop_hash_global_stop:{question['question_id']}:{region.get('page_number')}")
+            region_count += 1
+    return {"papers": paper_receipts, "question_count": len(questions), "region_count": region_count}
+
+
+def normalize_text(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None
+    return unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", value).strip()
+
+
+def normalize_label(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    text = normalize_text(value)
+    if text is None or not text:
+        return None
+    compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", text).lower()
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"\(?([a-z])\)?(?:\(?([ivx]+)\)?)?", compact)
+    if match:
+        outer, inner = match.groups()
+        return outer if inner is None else f"{outer}({inner})"
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"\(?([ivx]+)\)?", compact)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def normalize_notes(value: Any, warnings: list[str], field: str) -> list[str]:
+    if value is None:
+        return []
+    values = [value] if isinstance(value, str) else value if isinstance(value, list) else None
+    if values is None:
+        warnings.append(f"{field}_wrong_type")
+        return []
+    result = []
+    for item in values:
+        text = normalize_text(item)
+        if text:
+            result.append(text)
+        elif item is not None:
+            warnings.append(f"{field}_item_wrong_type_or_empty")
+    return result
+
+
+def normalize_candidate(candidate: dict[str, Any], source: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[str], bool]:
+    warnings: list[str] = []
+    needs_review = False
+    raw_labels = candidate.get("visible_subparts")
+    labels: list[str] = []
+    if not isinstance(raw_labels, list):
+        warnings.append("visible_subparts_missing_or_wrong_type")
+        needs_review = True
+    else:
+        for value in raw_labels:
+            normalized = normalize_label(value)
+            if normalized is None:
+                warnings.append("visible_subpart_ambiguous")
+                needs_review = True
+            else:
+                labels.append(normalized)
+                if value != normalized:
+                    warnings.append("visible_subpart_representation_normalized")
+
+    raw_marks = candidate.get("visible_marks")
+    marks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    if not isinstance(raw_marks, list):
+        warnings.append("visible_marks_missing_or_wrong_type")
+        needs_review = True
+    else:
+        for row in raw_marks:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                warnings.append("visible_mark_row_wrong_type")
+                needs_review = True
+                continue
+            owner = normalize_label(row.get("owner"))
+            value = row.get("marks")
+            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().isdigit():
+                value = int(value.strip())
+                warnings.append("visible_mark_value_normalized")
+            if owner is None or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
+                warnings.append("visible_mark_ambiguous")
+                needs_review = True
+            marks.append({"owner": owner, "marks": value, "raw": row})
+
+    question_number = candidate.get("question_number")
+    if question_number != source["question_number"]:
+        warnings.append("reported_question_number_mismatch")
+        needs_review = True
+    page_chain = candidate.get("complete_page_chain")
+    if page_chain != source["complete_page_chain"]:
+        warnings.append("reported_page_chain_mismatch")
+        needs_review = True
+
+    required_visuals = candidate.get("required_visuals")
+    contamination = candidate.get("contamination")
+    if not isinstance(required_visuals, list):
+        warnings.append("required_visuals_missing_or_wrong_type")
+        needs_review = True
+        required_visuals = []
+    if not isinstance(contamination, dict):
+        warnings.append("contamination_missing_or_wrong_type")
+        needs_review = True
+        contamination = {}
+
+    enhancement = candidate.get("candidate_enhancement")
+    if not isinstance(enhancement, dict):
+        if enhancement is not None:
+            warnings.append("candidate_enhancement_wrong_type")
+        enhancement = {}
+    notes = {
+        key: normalize_notes(candidate.get(key, enhancement.get(key)), warnings, key)
+        for key in ("reading_order_notes", "semantic_notes", "formula_notes", "transcription_notes")
+    }
+    normalized = {
+        "paper_id": source["paper_id"],
+        "question_id": source["question_id"],
+        "question_number": source["question_number"],
+        "complete_page_chain": source["complete_page_chain"],
+        "visible_subparts": labels,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "required_visuals": required_visuals,
+        "contamination": contamination,
+        "notes": notes,
+        "candidate_transcription": candidate.get("candidate_transcription", enhancement.get("candidate_transcription")),
+        "candidate_formula_text": candidate.get("candidate_formula_text", enhancement.get("candidate_formula_text")),
+    }
+    return normalized, sorted(set(warnings)), needs_review
+
+
+def parse_provider_candidate(response: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
+    choices = response.get("choices")
+    if not isinstance(choices, list) or not choices or not isinstance(choices[0], dict):
+        raise ValueError("missing_choices")
+    message = choices[0].get("message")
+    if not isinstance(message, dict):
+        raise ValueError("missing_message")
+    content = message.get("content")
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        content = "".join(part.get("text", "") for part in content if isinstance(part, dict))
+    if not isinstance(content, str) or not content.strip():
+        raise ValueError("missing_content")
+    text = content.strip()
+    fenced = re.fullmatch(r"```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)\s*```", text, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
+    if fenced:
+        text = fenced.group(1)
+    candidate = json.loads(text)
+    if not isinstance(candidate, dict):
+        raise ValueError("candidate_not_object")
+    return candidate, content
+
+
+def price_usage(response: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, int] | None, float, bool]:
+    usage = response.get("usage")
+    if not isinstance(usage, dict):
+        return None, MAX_CALL_EXPOSURE_CNY, True
+    prompt = usage.get("prompt_tokens")
+    completion = usage.get("completion_tokens")
+    if not isinstance(prompt, int) or not isinstance(completion, int) or prompt < 0 or completion < 0:
+        return None, MAX_CALL_EXPOSURE_CNY, True
+    for ceiling, input_price, output_price in PRICE_TIERS:
+        if prompt <= ceiling:
+            cost = round(prompt / 1_000_000 * input_price + completion / 1_000_000 * output_price, 9)
+            return {"prompt_tokens": prompt, "completion_tokens": completion}, cost, False
+    return {"prompt_tokens": prompt, "completion_tokens": completion}, MAX_CALL_EXPOSURE_CNY, True
+
+
+def build_prompt(source: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return (
+        "Return one JSON object only. Inspect the ordered official public exam question crops. Do not solve the "
+        "question or provide an answer. Record visible candidate data; uncertainty is allowed. "
+        f"question_id={source['question_id']}; expected_question_number={source['question_number']}; "
+        f"expected_page_chain={json.dumps(source['complete_page_chain'])}. Required keys: question_number, "
+        "complete_page_chain, visible_subparts, visible_marks (array of owner/marks), required_visuals, "
+        "contamination, candidate_transcription, candidate_formula_text, reading_order_notes, semantic_notes, "
+        "formula_notes, transcription_notes. Notes may be strings or arrays. Candidate data is not formal truth."
+    )
+
+
+def build_request(source: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    content: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"type": "text", "text": build_prompt(source)}]
+    for region in source["regions"]:
+        content.append({"type": "image_path", "image_path": region["crop_external_path"]})
+    request = {
+        "model": MODEL,
+        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
+        "max_tokens": MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
+        "temperature": 0,
+        "enable_thinking": False,
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+    }
+    serialized = canonical_bytes(request).lower()
+    for term in FORBIDDEN_TERMS:
+        if term.encode() in serialized:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"forbidden_payload_global_stop:{term}")
+    for key_name in ("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"):
+        secret = os.environ.get(key_name)
+        if secret and secret.encode() in serialized:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"credential_in_payload_global_stop:{key_name}")
+    return request
+
+
+def spent_cny() -> float:
+    return round(sum(float(row["charged_or_reserved_cny"]) for row in load_jsonl(EXTERNAL_LEDGER)), 9)
+
+
+def assert_budget_before_call() -> None:
+    successor_after = round(CARRYOVER_RESERVED_CNY + spent_cny() + MAX_CALL_EXPOSURE_CNY, 9)
+    if successor_after > SUCCESSOR_CAP_CNY or PREDECESSOR_AGGREGATE_CNY + successor_after > AGGREGATE_CAP_CNY:
+        raise RuntimeError("possible_budget_breach_global_stop")
+
+
+def retryable_provider_error(error: QwenOpenAIClientError) -> bool:
+    message = str(error).lower()
+    if "http " in message:
+        return any(f"http {status}" in message for status in (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504))
+    return any(marker in message for marker in (
+        "non-json", "timed out", "timeout", "urlopen error", "remote end closed",
+        "connection reset", "temporary failure", "failed without a response body",
+    ))
+

+def attempt_question(source: dict[str, Any], ordinal: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    request = build_request(source)
+    request_hash = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(request))
+    retry_errors: list[str] = []
+    for attempt_number in range(1, MAX_RETRIES + 2):
+        assert_budget_before_call()
+        attempt_id = f"{RUN_ID}-{ordinal:02d}-{attempt_number}-{request_hash[:12]}"
+        package = ATTEMPTS / attempt_id
+        reservation = {
+            "schema_version": "9709_completion_first_attempt_v1",
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "run_id": RUN_ID,
+            "attempt_id": attempt_id,
+            "question_id": source["question_id"],
+            "attempt_number": attempt_number,
+            "provider": "Alibaba Cloud Model Studio DashScope",
+            "model": MODEL,
+            "endpoint": f"{DEFAULT_BASE_URL}/chat/completions",
+            "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
+            "request_sha256": request_hash,
+            "input_crop_sha256": [row["crop_sha256"] for row in source["regions"]],
+            "successor_spend_before_cny": round(CARRYOVER_RESERVED_CNY + spent_cny(), 9),
+            "aggregate_spend_before_cny": round(PREDECESSOR_AGGREGATE_CNY + CARRYOVER_RESERVED_CNY + spent_cny(), 9),
+            "maximum_call_exposure_cny": MAX_CALL_EXPOSURE_CNY,
+        }
+        write_new(package / "reservation.json", canonical_bytes(reservation))
+        write_new(package / "request.json", canonical_bytes({**reservation, "request": request}))
+        response: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+        response_hash: str | None = None
+        response_id: str | None = None
+        usage: dict[str, int] | None = None
+        charged = MAX_CALL_EXPOSURE_CNY
+        usage_missing = True
+        retry_reason: str | None = None
+        try:
+            response = call_qwen_openai_v1_direct(request, base_url=DEFAULT_BASE_URL, timeout=120, max_retries=0)
+            raw = canonical_bytes(response)
+            write_new(package / "response.raw.json", raw)
+            response_hash = sha256_bytes(raw)
+            response_id = response.get("id") if isinstance(response.get("id"), str) else None
+            usage, charged, usage_missing = price_usage(response)
+            finish_reason = (response.get("choices") or [{}])[0].get("finish_reason") if isinstance(response.get("choices"), list) else None
+            candidate, _ = parse_provider_candidate(response)
